observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: dance studio with wooden floor and wall mural
observation.formation_and_space: initially a line, then shifting to a staggered formation, then a V-shape, and finally a line
observation.posture: upright torso, knees slightly bent, weight shifts between feet
observation.footwork: small, rhythmic steps, often involving side-to-side weight shifts and turns; exact footwork is obscured by the long skirts
observation.arms_and_hands: arms are held out to the sides, often waving or lifting the skirts; hands are used to manipulate the fabric of the skirts
observation.hips_and_torso: prominent hip movements, including side-to-side sways and circular motions
observation.levels_jumps_turns: dancers perform turns, and occasionally drop to their knees
observation.costume_and_props: colorful, long, flowing skirts and matching crop tops
observation.cannot_infer: exact footwork is obscured by the long skirts; the speed of the movements makes it difficult to distinguish individual steps

signature_moments.what: dancers sway hips side-to-side while holding out their skirts
dancers perform a synchronized turn while holding their skirts out
dancers raise their arms above their heads while swaying hips
dancers drop to their knees and continue to move their arms and hips
dancers perform a quick, synchronized turn while moving their skirts
